observations.body: They took their journey from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Israel came to the wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifte…
observations.label: Text in view

observations.body: The congregation reaches Sin, complains, and receives bread from heaven.
observations.label: Hunger in Sin

observations.body: The wilderness becomes a daily gathering place where bread, trust, work, and rest are tested.
observations.label: Wilderness role

payload.posture: Read Exodus 16:1–5 as its own wilderness scene before relating it to other journeys, memories, or visions.
payload.tension: Provision answers hunger without erasing the congregation’s complaint about Egypt.
payload.title: Bread in the wilderness
